summary: Netcapital Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the immediate resignation of CEO and director Cecilia Lenk on August 19, 2026, following court approval of her SEC settlement. She resigned from the board and from her role at subsidiary Netcapital Advisors Inc., with no disagreement cited. Lenk consented to permanent injunctions and a $50,000 penalty without admitting wrongdoing. The SEC civil action continues against the company and other defendants. Todd Violette, formerly a director, has assumed the role of CEO. Watch for further SEC case developments and any governance or strategic shifts under new leadership.
